perks.name: Vorpal Weapon

perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Fleet Footed

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

notes: Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@cammycakesgaming (PvP PvP-Duel PvP-God M+KB Controller): God-roll PvP roll for duelling - even with the Ash and Iron nerf, Forgiveness is still an excellent close range primary option. The Heavy Burst frame can be useful in reducing flinch when ADSed. As per the @hugowo_ spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/, at 100 Weapon attribute, best base TTK is 0.733s (4 crits 1 body) and 70% accuracy adjusted TTK is 0.833s (2c 4b). This pairs well with the Hunter Mask of Bakris ×1.06 damage boost for 11s after a shift, which reduces accuracy needed to 3c 2b. The stats, are generally better than its recent peers, except for lower range attribute - but this has less effect with the compressed range on sidearms. For the barrel perk, Corkscrew Rifling bumps up the major gunfeel attributes, or you can take Recoil Direction to 100 with either Extended Barrel or Chambered Compensator. Ricochet Rounds is the best of the magazine perks - you can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/1552443158 for yourself. Look for a consistency perk in the first trait perk column to help with crits. Zen Moment, stacks up to ×5 on hits to reduce flinch and visual shake - very useful on controllers. There's also Tap the Trigger which for 0.6s (0.76s when enhanced) on a trigger pull provides +40 Stability, ×0.5 recoil and ×0.9 Accuracy Cone size. In the second column, Precision Instrument grants escalating damage on repeated crit hits up to ×1.25 at ×6 stacks (×1.3 when enhanced) for 1.25s or until you miss a crit. Mask of Bakris and Precision Instrument together reduce the TTK to 0.47 (4c 0b). For the Origin Trait, Fleet Footed stacks up to ×1 on hits and ×2 on kills to boost movement speed and Airborne Effectiveness - great for a mobile playstyle - or Roar of Battle grants +10 Stability and Handling for 6s after dealing or taking damage every 0.5s or so for 2s. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost Range, Handling, Airborne Effectiveness depending on your play style.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 152 from 2 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5y3KdXwOHAdEiERuX1NtGR?si=87414268eb9642d6) with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for dealing with groups of Minor adds and occasional higher ranked enemies in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with an arc build. The Heavy Burst frame Forgiveness means it's towards the bottom of the sidearm subfamilies for enemy damage, unfortunately and like all primary ammo sidearms it lives in the shadow of the micro-missile frame varieties. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good, which is improved further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and mag perks are enhanced - d2foundry.gg calculates that 45 Range equates to 12.80m hipfire and 15.36m ADS before damage dropoff, 41 Stability is ×1.0525 flinch resist, 39 Handling is 0.32s ready, 0.26s ADS and 0.35s stow speed, 24 Reload Speed is 1.86s reload and Magazine Size is 24 (max 38) - firing two bullets per trigger pull, that's 12 shots. The range is very compressed on sidearms, so go for a barrel perk that provids Stability on Controller or Handling on M+KB. For the magazine, look for a perk that boosts Reload Speed. If you don't already have a Voltshot sidearm, you have the option of that with Loose Change as the trait perks, to apply Jolt to the next target you hit within 7s (8s when enhanced), after a reload within 5.3s of a kill, for chunk damage on the target plus AoE damage on nearby enemies. While Loose Change only helps after the first time you apply Jolt, providing +50 Reload Speed +20 Aim Assist and ×1.2 ADS movement speed, it does mean that once you start a spree it's easier to keep it going. The Fleet Footed Origin Trait's additional Airborne Effectiveness and Movement Speed are more of a PvP perk. Roar of Battle's +10 Handling and Stability is better, but unspectacular. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Forgiveness is shaping up to be a more focused Brass Attacks. Brass Attacks could roll a reload perk and damage perk, making it neutrally strong. Forgiveness has two reload bypassing perks in subsistence and demolitionist. Vorpal and grenade focus are great and fall into different use cases. If you already have a Brass Attacks, I don’t see a need for this in your rotation. But if you would prefer a grenade heavy build than Forgiveness is a great pick." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Forgiveness will be incredible in PvP. With a base air accuracy stat of 25, Adept Icarus adding +15, and Air Assault giving up to 60 as your health drops, you could have 100 air accuracy with rapid hit, ricochet rounds and a 17m effective range. [...] go for something like demolitionist for the added ability energy and multikill clip for the lethality. If you really like grenade builds in PvP and can secure those grenade kills then adrenaline junkie is the best pick for you. Some great neutral perks are moving target for the flat bonus to aim assist, and rapid hit to make securing that first kill easier." Recommended MW - Range.
